en: Black-and-white postcard showing a large neoclassical government building with two stories, a central entrance, many windows, and a flag above the main doorway. The building stands in an open square with several trees protected by wooden crates. Printed captions in Portuguese and French at the bottom identify the scene as the Government Palace in the city of Praia, Cabo Verde (Cape Verde).
